flags.summary: On Oct. 2, 2026 the Vigo County School Board voted 6-0 to censure Warner over his personal social media comments about a local criminal case involving possession of child sexual abuse material; he says his comments were taken out of context.
flags.note: Kept in the public profile by editor decision; revisit. A censure is a formal public statement of disapproval; it does not remove a member. Warner is running unopposed for District 4.

sources.title: Vigo school board censures member Ken Warner
Vigo County School Board unanimously votes to censure member Ken Warner
